usedFor: Checklist progress in CheckFlow, such as “Task Is Completed”, creates, tags or moves contacts in LeadConnector.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Is Completed” in CheckFlow, then “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A finished task adds a contact to, or removes it from, a LeadConnector workflow, found by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: Use “Create Or Update Contact” rather than “Create Contact” if one person can fire “Task Is Completed” repeatedly.
